messages.Încetinit: 0,1 s simulat / s real: Slow motion: 0.1 simulated s / real s
messages.Timp real: 1 s simulat / s real: Real time: 1 simulated s / real s
messages.Pas = 0,005 s simulate. Schimbarea param: Step = 0.005 simulated s. Changing parameters while paused starts a new measurement. Playback rate does not change the physics.
messages.La frecvențe mari, rotația poate părea i: At high frequencies, rotation may appear reversed or slow due to display sampling. Follow the graphs and readings.
messages.Curbele sunt predicții ale modelului. Li: The curves are model predictions. The vertical line marks the current time.
messages.Puterea mecanică furnizată de antrenor s: Mechanical power supplied by the drive becomes useful power and coil heating. The magnetic field is not a source of free energy.
messages.Tensiunea indusă și tensiunea la borne î: Induced EMF and terminal voltage versus time
messages.Un antrenor extern rotește bobina cu vit: An external drive rotates the coil at constant angular velocity. The field is uniform and constant, but the orientation of the coil changes. The flux varies and an EMF is induced.
messages.Unghiul θ se măsoară între câmpul B și n: Angle θ is measured between field B and the coil normal n, not between the field and the coil plane. The positive winding direction follows the right-hand rule about n.
messages.Φ este fluxul printr-o singură spiră. NΦ: Φ is the flux through one turn. NΦ is the flux linkage. At maximum flux, its instantaneous rate of change is zero, so e = 0. When flux crosses zero, the magnitude of the EMF is maximum.
messages.Aceste două relații descriu circuitul în: These two relations describe a closed circuit. In an open circuit: i = 0 and u = e. In a short circuit: R = 0, u = 0 and i = e/r; internal resistance limits the current.
messages.Momentul electromagnetic se opune rotați: Electromagnetic torque opposes rotation. The drive compensates for this torque to maintain speed. The mechanical energy supplied equals useful energy plus internally dissipated energy.
messages.Valorile efective sunt calculate pentru: RMS values describe a complete sinusoidal cycle with constant parameters. In a resistive circuit, current is in phase with the induced EMF. Two slip rings preserve alternating polarity; a split-ring commutator would change the terminal waveform.
messages.Model analitic: câmp uniform impus, spir: Analytical model: prescribed uniform field, identical rigid turns, prescribed speed, purely resistive load and negligible inductance. It excludes inductive transients, saturation, armature reaction, friction and temperature-dependent resistance.
messages.N și rezistența internă sunt parametri i: N and internal resistance are independent parameters here. In a real coil, changing the number of turns can change resistance too. The ratio R/(R+r) covers only the included Joule losses, not the full efficiency of a real generator.
messages.Reprezentarea este schematică. Luminozit: The drawing is schematic. Indicator brightness follows useful power, not a real light bulb characteristic. Arrows show conventional current; electrons oscillate rather than travelling around the whole circuit each half-cycle.
messages.SI: B în tesla (T), A în m², flux în web: SI: B in tesla (T), A in m², flux in weber (Wb), ω in rad/s, t in s, voltages in V, current in A, resistances in Ω, power in W, energy in J, torque in N·m. N is dimensionless.
messages.Condiții inițiale: pauză, t = 0 s, θ = 0: Initial conditions: paused, t = 0 s, θ = 0, N = 100, B = 0.5 T, A = 0.01 m², ω = 10π rad/s, R = 20 Ω and r = 2 Ω. Reset returns energies to zero.
messages.Compară cazul de referință cu dublarea l: Compare the reference case with doubling N or B. What changes in amplitude and what stays constant in frequency?
messages.Oprește la flux maxim și apoi la flux ze: Pause at maximum flux and then at zero flux. Compare the induced EMF. Explain the difference using the rate of change of flux.
messages.Deschide circuitul: observă că tensiunea: Open the circuit: observe that voltage remains while current and powers are zero. Identify the role of a closed circuit.
messages.Redu rezistența sarcinii, inclusiv la ze: Reduce load resistance, including to zero. Compare useful power with internal heating and explain why a short circuit supplies no useful power.
messages.O bobină cu 100 de spire, aria 0,01 m² ș: A 100-turn coil of area 0.01 m² and internal resistance 2 Ω rotates in a 0.5 T field at 5 Hz. The load is 20 Ω. Find the maximum EMF and current at t = 0.05 s, starting at θ = 0.
messages.ω = 2πf = 10π rad/s. Emax = NBAω = 5π V: ω = 2πf = 10π rad/s. Emax = NBAω = 5π V ≈ 15.708 V. At t = 0.05 s, θ = π/2 and e = Emax. Current i = e/(R+r) ≈ 0.714 A, while terminal voltage u ≈ 14.280 V.
messages.Pentru aceeași bobină, calculează puteri: For the same coil, calculate average powers and energy supplied during one period.
messages.Ief = Emax/[√2(R+r)] ≈ 0,504873 A. Puter: Irms = Emax/[√2(R+r)] ≈ 0.504873 A. Average useful power is Irms²R ≈ 5.097936 W and average internal loss is Irms²r ≈ 0.509794 W. The drive supplies an average of 5.607730 W. Over T = 0.2 s, mechanical energy is 1.121546 J, equal to useful energy plus internal loss.
messages.La flux maxim, tensiunea indusă este…: At maximum flux, the induced EMF is…
messages.Tensiunea depinde de viteza de variație: The EMF depends on the rate of change of flux, which is zero at a flux extremum.
messages.Cu circuitul deschis și bobina în rotați: With an open circuit and rotating coil…
messages.La circuit deschis, i = 0, dar tensiunea: In an open circuit, i = 0, but terminal voltage equals e.
messages.aceeași frecvență și tensiune dublă: the same frequency and twice the voltage
messages.frecvență dublă și tensiune maximă dublă: twice the frequency and twice the peak voltage
messages.Atât frecvența, cât și amplitudinea tens: Both frequency and EMF amplitude are proportional to the magnitude of angular velocity.
messages.Energia electrică furnizată provine din…: The electrical energy supplied comes from…
messages.Antrenorul furnizează energia; generator: The drive supplies energy; the generator converts it while conserving energy.
messages.variația fluxului care produce inducția: the flux change that causes induction
messages.Curentul indus se opune variației fluxul: Induced current opposes the change in flux, not always the existing field.
messages.La scurtcircuit cu rezistență internă ne: In a short circuit with nonzero internal resistance…
messages.puterea utilă este zero, iar bobina se î: useful power is zero and the coil heats up
messages.Rezistența internă limitează curentul; R: Internal resistance limits current; R = 0 means zero useful power.
messages.Documentare prin Firecrawl la 3 noiembri: Researched using Firecrawl on 3 November 2026. This laboratory models a rotating coil in a uniform field. PhET uses a rotating magnet next to a stationary coil: compare the principle of induction, without equating the two geometries numerically.
messages.Notă despre exemplul OpenStax 13.6: pent: Note on OpenStax example 13.6: for the quarter-turn in 15 ms, approximately 131.6 V is the instantaneous peak, although the text calls it an average. The correct average over the quarter-turn is 83.78 V. Distinguish peak, interval-average and RMS values.
messages.Alternator 3D cu înfășurare, două inele: 3D alternator with winding, two slip rings, fixed brushes and complete circuit
messages.Înfășurarea și cele două inele complete: The winding and two complete slip rings rotate with the shaft. Each winding end connects to a separate ring, insulated from the other. Fixed carbon brushes maintain contact with the rings. The ideal ammeter is in series with the load; the ideal voltmeter connects to generator terminals a and b. In a closed circuit, terminal voltage also equals load voltage. Wire colours identify the two conductors, not a permanent current direction. The visible turns are representative; the physical number of turns is N.
